s0.ru: Слов {n}, каждое из двух символов 0 или 1: {words}. Слова добавляются в дерево слева направо. Новый узел появляется, только если такого продолжения ещё не было. Корень не считается. Сколько узлов создано?
s0.en: There are {n} words, each made of two symbols 0 or 1: {words}. Words are added to the tree from left to right. A new node appears only when that continuation did not exist yet. The root is not counted. How many nodes are created?

s1.en: There are {n} words, each made of two symbols 0 or 1: {words}. Words are added to the tree from left to right. A new node appears only when that continuation did not exist yet. The root is not counted. How many words created at least one new node?
